 By 
 Kitty Guo ,
 a writer at the Strategist covering beauty, fashion, and gifts.

 Black Friday is still almost two weeks away, but the early deals are already rolling in — and there are enough gift-worthy goodies marked down that I highly suggest you start your holiday shopping now. I’ve rounded up a bevy of on-sale items that would make great gifts, including lots of winter-ready Cashsoft accessories at Gap, a bag charm that can be personalized with monogramming, and a charming Hoptimist that doubles as a Bluetooth speaker .
 To make it easier to shop, everything below is organized by price so you can click ahead to the section that best fits your budget. For even more deals, check out senior deals editor Sam Daly ’s guide to shopping this year’s Black Friday sales , save the products you’ve got your eye on that we think will go on sale so we can notify you when prices drop, and sign up for the Strategist Deal Freaks Daily newsletter to receive each day’s best deals directly in your inbox.
